jobs.name: stone-house-wide-v2
jobs.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Make ONE new editorial photograph of the same MySpice appliance, rephotographed from the camera position described below. The three input images are GEOMETRY AND MATERIAL REFERENCES ONLY, not a flat cutout to paste. Reconstruct the object in the scene's true perspective. Invariants: same wide satin-silver case, charcoal top lid and bottom collector strip, clear slender vertical spice tubes, tiny circular button and a closed recessed phone support with narrow silver lip. No phone or tablet. Appliance actual dimensions fixed across every photograph: WIDTH 660mm, HEIGHT 360mm, DEPTH 80mm. Never enlarge it to fill a backsplash or turn it into a cabinet. Scale anchors: standard base cabinet module 600mm wide; worktop 900mm above floor and 600mm deep; wall-cabinet underside 1500mm above floor; appliance bottom 1020mm and top 1380mm above floor where wall cabinetry is present. Thus MySpice is about 1.1 times ONE standard cabinet's width and 60% of a 600mm-high backsplash. Maintain correct object proportions even under perspective. Fine-grained real spices, subdued earthly color, small herb flakes; no giant peppercorns. Editorial analog-style architectural photography, tactile materials, subtle grain, neutral whites, no orange cast, oversaturation, CGI plastic, heavy HDR, halos or oversharpening. Fictional interiors, no text, signage, logos, ratings or watermarks. SHOT 01 / DISTANT ARCHITECTURAL ESTABLISHING VIEW. Landscape 16:9. Camera about FIVE METRES from the kitchen wall, 28mm architectural lens at 1.4m height, looking diagonally across an ENTIRE spacious luxury limestone and pale oak kitchen. Show the full large island in the foreground, stools at one end, a wall of tall oak cabinets and a wide bank of lower cupboards. Keep verticals straight and the room realistically proportioned. The product is a modest functional object mounted on the back prep wall above ONE 600mm cabinet, only 12–16% of the image width. It must remain recognizable but must NOT become the main close-up. The photograph should clearly read as a room-wide interior, not a product hero. Airy daylight, warm limestone, oat-toned oak, one restrained ceramic vessel. Beautiful calm editorial architecture.

macroRefinement.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit.
